verdict.rationale: CAM documents a national Employment practice covering employee disputes, workplace and policy issues, investigations, retention and restructuring. It also says it helps startups standardize their key documents, and its IP practice covers unpatented technology. None of this explicitly mentions drafting hiring paperwork, so the story is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of drafting offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements, plus independent corroboration.
